# Blank Lines

10 options in this group.

| Key | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations](csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations.md) | `1` | Maximum consecutive blank lines between members. |
| [csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_code](csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_code.md) | `1` | Maximum consecutive blank lines between statements. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable](csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable.md) | `0` | Blank lines before and after each method or constructor. 0 means leave the author's. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_around_type](csharp_blank_lines_around_type.md) | `0` | Blank lines before and after each type declaration. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_around_property](csharp_blank_lines_around_property.md) | `0` | Blank lines before and after each property, indexer or event. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_around_field](csharp_blank_lines_around_field.md) | `0` | Blank lines before and after each field. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_inside_type](csharp_blank_lines_inside_type.md) | `0` | Blank lines below the opening brace and above the closing brace of a type. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace](csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace.md) | `0` | Blank lines before and after a namespace declaration. |
| [csharp_blank_lines_after_using_list](csharp_blank_lines_after_using_list.md) | `0` | Blank lines below the last using directive. |
